gen-gf-bellota-gf-lato: Bellota draws every stroke like neon tubing, its s ends hanging far from the spine. And Lato, a plain sans with wide, barely curled s curves, can be sized up a little for body text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-libre-franklin: Bellota lays down every letter as a plain stripe of constant ink, its s ends hanging far from the spine. Libre Franklin brings splayed c terminals for the stripe to push against.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-livvic: Livvic reads friendly and unstressed, a sans-serif with generous c openings. Beneath Bellota, whose strokes all share one stylus width, a full page of Livvic would move along in an unhurried, easygoing way.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-lunasima: Wire-bent letters with uniform counters lead the way in Bellota. Lunasima, a sans-serif whose c tips never drift toward touching, gives those framed counters a looser neighbor right beneath them.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: Gentle weight shifts and a bracelet-wide c make the body glide beside Bellota, with its bent-rod strokes. LXGW Marker Gothic, a sans with a modest gradient, keeps a full stretch of text smooth and contemporary.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-m-plus-1: M PLUS 1 reads like fineliner on paper, a sans with big open eyes on every e and a. But Bellota is the one for attention, with its tube-like strokes, while the body handles the running text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-m-plus-1p: Blunt, untapered stroke ends give Bellota a look nobody could mistake. M PLUS 1p, a plain sans open at every curve end, supplies the loose-ended counterpoint that makes the pairing memorable.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-m-plus-2: Approachable fits M PLUS 2, whose plain sans letters have a gaping c opening and a single fixed nib width. Bellota grabs the eye first, while the body simply carries the text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine, every stroke traced at one stylus width. M PLUS Code Latin, plain sans with pitcher-mouth c, feels friendlier beside it.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: M PLUS Rounded 1c reads soft, terminals stopping short of curling back. Against Bellota, whose letters are built from one width of stroke, that softness makes a sturdy, friendly pairing.
